_source: Pre-first-run fallback only: the pipeline recomputes this per chamber every run (score_calculator.compute_les_reference) and writes /data/les_reference.json, which takes precedence. These values predate v6.14's stage-normalized credit and carry no stage_totals, so a fresh install scores the Volden & Wiseman component neutral until its first pipeline run; regenerate on the new scale with backend/scripts/calibrate_les_credit_scale.py against a production database. advancement_rates are the 2026-07 corpus rates (Senate 3.6%/2.4% over 24,294 bills, House 6.4%/2.4% over 13,510).
